{"type":"assistant","message":{"id":"05c787a114981dbd559ad3e8b1918386","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"call_function_ryfa7hv1kj0d_1","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/root/fraud_analyzer.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nInvoice Fraud Detection Script\nAnalyzes invoices against vendor and purchase order data to detect fraud.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport pandas as pd\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation\nfrom difflib import SequenceMatcher\nimport PyPDF2\nimport pdfplumber\nfrom typing import List, Dict, Optional, Tuple\n\ndef similarity(a: str, b: str) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Calculate similarity between two strings using SequenceMatcher.\"\"\"\n    return SequenceMatcher(None, a.lower(), b.lower()).ratio()\n\ndef extract_invoice_data(pdf_path: str) -> List[Dict]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract invoice data from PDF.\n    Returns list of dicts with page_number, vendor_name, amount, iban, po_number.\n    \"\"\"\n    invoices = []\n\n    try:\n        with pdfplumber.open(pdf_path) as pdf:\n            for page_num, page in enumerate(pdf.pages, start=1):\n                text = page.extract_text()\n                if not text:\n                    continue\n\n                # Initialize invoice data\n                invoice_data = {\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": page_num,\n                    \"vendor_name\": None,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": None,\n                    \"iban\": None,\n                    \"po_number\": None\n                }\n\n                # Extract vendor name (usually at the top)\n                # Look for patterns like \"Vendor:\", \"From:\", or company names\n                vendor_patterns = [\n                    r'Vendor[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'From[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'Company[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'Supplier[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in vendor_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        vendor_name = match.group(1).strip()\n                        # Clean up common suffixes\n                        vendor_name = re.sub(r'\\s+(Ltd|Limited|Inc|Corp|Corporation|LLC|LLP)\\.?$', '', vendor_name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n                        vendor_name = vendor_name.strip()\n                        if len(vendor_name) > 2:\n                            invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = vendor_name\n                            break\n\n                # If no vendor found, try to find first line that looks like a company name\n                if not invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"]:\n                    lines = text.split('\\n')\n                    for line in lines[:10]:  # Check first 10 lines\n                        line = line.strip()\n                        if line and len(line) > 3 and not re.match(r'^(invoice|amount|total|date|#|no|number)', line, re.IGNORECASE):\n                            # Likely a vendor name\n                            invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = line\n                            break\n\n                # Extract amount (look for Total, Amount Due, etc.)\n                amount_patterns = [\n                    r'Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Amount Due[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Balance[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Grand Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Total Amount[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in amount_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        try:\n                            invoice_data[\"invoice_amount\"] = float(match.group(1))\n                            break\n                        except (ValueError, InvalidOperation):\n                            pass\n\n                # Extract IBAN (look for IBAN keyword or long alphanumeric strings)\n                iban_patterns = [\n                    r'IBAN[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)',\n                    r'Account[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in iban_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = match.group(1).strip()\n                        break\n\n                # If no IBAN found, look for long alphanumeric strings (15-34 chars)\n                if not invoice_data[\"iban\"]:\n                    iban_match = re.search(r'\\b([A-Z0-9]{15,34})\\b', text)\n                    if iban_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = iban_match.group(1)\n\n                # Extract PO Number\n                po_patterns = [\n                    r'PO Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'PO[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'Purchase Order[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'Order Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in po_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        invoice_data[\"po_number\"] = match.group(1).strip()\n                        break\n\n                invoices.append(invoice_data)\n\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error reading PDF: {e}\")\n        # Fallback to PyPDF2\n        try:\n            with open(pdf_path, 'rb') as f:\n                pdf_reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(f)\n                for page_num, page in enumerate(pdf_reader.pages, start=1):\n                    text = page.extract_text()\n                    if not text:\n                        continue\n\n                    invoice_data = {\n                        \"invoice_page_number\": page_num,\n                        \"vendor_name\": None,\n                        \"invoice_amount\": None,\n                        \"iban\": None,\n                        \"po_number\": None\n                    }\n\n                    # Extract similar to above\n                    vendor_match = re.search(r'Vendor[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if vendor_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = vendor_match.group(1).strip()\n\n                    amount_match = re.search(r'Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if amount_match:\n                        try:\n                            invoice_data[\"invoice_amount\"] = float(amount_match.group(1))\n                        except ValueError:\n                            pass\n\n                    iban_match = re.search(r'IBAN[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if iban_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = iban_match.group(1)\n\n                    po_match = re.search(r'PO Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if po_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"po_number\"] = po_match.group(1)\n\n                    invoices.append(invoice_data)\n        except Exception as e2:\n            print(f\"Error with PyPDF2 fallback: {e2}\")\n\n    return invoices\n\ndef normalize_vendor_name(name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Normalize vendor name for comparison.\"\"\"\n    if not name:\n        return \"\"\n    # Remove common business suffixes and normalize\n    name = re.sub(r'\\s+(Ltd|Limited|Inc|Corporation|Corp|LLC|LLP)\\.?$', '', name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n    # Remove extra spaces and convert to lowercase\n    return re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', name.strip().lower())\n\ndef detect_fraud(invoices: List[Dict], vendors_df: pd.DataFrame, po_df: pd.DataFrame) -> List[Dict]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Detect fraudulent invoices based on the criteria.\n    Returns list of fraudulent invoices with reasons.\n    \"\"\"\n    fraud_cases = []\n\n    # Create lookup dictionaries\n    vendors_dict = {}\n    for _, row in vendors_df.iterrows():\n        vendor_id = row['Vendor ID']\n        vendor_name = row['Name']\n        vendor_iban = row['IBAN']\n        vendors_dict[normalize_vendor_name(vendor_name)] = {\n            'vendor_id': vendor_id,\n            'vendor_name': vendor_name,\n            'iban': vendor_iban\n        }\n\n    # Create PO lookup dictionary\n    po_dict = {}\n    for _, row in po_df.iterrows():\n        po_number = row['PO Number']\n        po_dict[po_number] = {\n            'po_number': po_number,\n            'amount': row['Amount'],\n            'vendor_id': row['Vendor ID']\n        }\n\n    for invoice in invoices:\n        vendor_name = invoice.get('vendor_name')\n        vendor_id = None\n        matched_vendor = None\n\n        # Criterion 1: Check if vendor exists (with fuzzy matching)\n        if vendor_name:\n            normalized_invoice_vendor = normalize_vendor_name(vendor_name)\n\n            # Exact match first\n            if normalized_invoice_vendor in vendors_dict:\n                matched_vendor = vendors_dict[normalized_invoice_vendor]\n                vendor_id = matched_vendor['vendor_id']\n            else:\n                # Fuzzy matching\n                best_match = None\n                best_score = 0.0\n\n                for normalized_vendor_name, vendor_info in vendors_dict.items():\n                    score = similarity(normalized_invoice_vendor, normalized_vendor_name)\n                    # Threshold for considering it a match (e.g., 0.85 or higher)\n                    if score > best_score and score >= 0.85:\n                        best_score = score\n                        best_match = vendor_info\n\n                if best_match:\n                    matched_vendor = best_match\n                    vendor_id = matched_vendor['vendor_id']\n                else:\n                    # Initialize invoice data\n                invoice_data = {\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": page_num,\n                    \"vendor_name\": None,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": None,\n                    \"iban\": None,\n                    \"po_number\": None\n                }\n\n                # Extract vendor name (usually at the top)\n                # Look for patterns like \"Vendor:\", \"From:\", or company names\n                vendor_patterns = [\n                    r'Vendor[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'From[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'Company[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'Supplier[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in vendor_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        vendor_name = match.group(1).strip()\n                        # Clean up common suffixes\n                        vendor_name = re.sub(r'\\s+(Ltd|Limited|Inc|Corp|Corporation|LLC|LLP)\\.?$', '', vendor_name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n                        vendor_name = vendor_name.strip()\n                        if len(vendor_name) > 2:\n                            invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = vendor_name\n                            break\n\n                # If no vendor found, try to find first line that looks like a company name\n                if not invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"]:\n                    lines = text.split('\\n')\n                    for line in lines[:10]:  # Check first 10 lines\n                        line = line.strip()\n                        if line and len(line) > 3 and not re.match(r'^(invoice|amount|total|date|#|no|number)', line, re.IGNORECASE):\n                            # Likely a vendor name\n                            invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = line\n                            break\n\n                # Extract amount (look for Total, Amount Due, etc.)\n                amount_patterns = [\n                    r'Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Amount Due[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Balance[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Grand Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Total Amount[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in amount_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        try:\n                            invoice_data[\"invoice_amount\"] = float(match.group(1))\n                            break\n                        except (ValueError, InvalidOperation):\n                            pass\n\n                # Extract IBAN (look for IBAN keyword or long alphanumeric strings)\n                iban_patterns = [\n                    r'IBAN[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)',\n                    r'Account[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in iban_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = match.group(1).strip()\n                        break\n\n                # If no IBAN found, look for long alphanumeric strings (15-34 chars)\n                if not invoice_data[\"iban\"]:\n                    iban_match = re.search(r'\\b([A-Z0-9]{15,34})\\b', text)\n                    if iban_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = iban_match.group(1)\n\n                # Extract PO Number\n                po_patterns = [\n                    r'PO Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'PO[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'Purchase Order[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'Order Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in po_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        invoice_data[\"po_number\"] = match.group(1).strip()\n                        break\n\n                invoices.append(invoice_data)\n\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error reading PDF: {e}\")\n        # Fallback to PyPDF2\n        try:\n            with open(pdf_path, 'rb') as f:\n                pdf_reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(f)\n                for page_num, page in enumerate(pdf_reader.pages, start=1):\n                    text = page.extract_text()\n                    if not text:\n                        continue\n\n                    invoice_data = {\n                        \"invoice_page_number\": page_num,\n                        \"vendor_name\": None,\n                        \"invoice_amount\": None,\n                        \"iban\": None,\n                        \"po_number\": None\n                    }\n\n                    # Extract similar to above\n                    vendor_match = re.search(r'Vendor[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if vendor_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = vendor_match.group(1).strip()\n\n                    amount_match = re.search(r'Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if amount_match:\n                        try:\n                            invoice_data[\"invoice_amount\"] = float(amount_match.group(1))\n                        except ValueError:\n                            pass\n\n                    iban_match = re.search(r'IBAN[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if iban_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = iban_match.group(1)\n\n                    po_match = re.search(r'PO Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if po_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"po_number\"] = po_match.group(1)\n\n                    invoices.append(invoice_data)\n        except Exception as e2:\n            print(f\"Error with PyPDF2 fallback: {e2}\")\n\n    return invoices\n\ndef normalize_vendor_name(name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Normalize vendor name for comparison.\"\"\"\n    if not name:\n        return \"\"\n    # Remove common business suffixes and normalize\n    name = re.sub(r'\\s+(Ltd|Limited|Inc|Corporation|Corp|LLC|LLP)\\.?$', '', name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n    # Remove extra spaces and convert to lowercase\n    return re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', name.strip().lower())\n\ndef detect_fraud(invoices: List[Dict], vendors_df: pd.DataFrame, po_df: pd.DataFrame) -> List[Dict]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Detect fraudulent invoices based on the criteria.\n    Returns list of fraudulent invoices with reasons.\n    \"\"\"\n    fraud_cases = []\n\n    # Create lookup dictionaries\n    vendors_dict = {}\n    for _, row in vendors_df.iterrows():\n        vendor_id = row['Vendor ID']\n        vendor_name = row['Name']\n        vendor_iban = row['IBAN']\n        vendors_dict[normalize_vendor_name(vendor_name)] = {\n            'vendor_id': vendor_id,\n            'vendor_name': vendor_name,\n            'iban': vendor_iban\n        }\n\n    # Create PO lookup dictionary\n    po_dict = {}\n    for _, row in po_df.iterrows():\n        po_number = row['PO Number']\n        po_dict[po_number] = {\n            'po_number': po_number,\n            'amount': row['Amount'],\n            'vendor_id': row['Vendor ID']\n        }\n\n    for invoice in invoices:\n        vendor_name = invoice.get('vendor_name')\n        vendor_id = None\n        matched_vendor = None\n\n        # Criterion 1: Check if vendor exists (with fuzzy matching)\n        if vendor_name:\n            normalized_invoice_vendor = normalize_vendor_name(vendor_name)\n\n            # Exact match first\n            if normalized_invoice_vendor in vendors_dict:\n                matched_vendor = vendors_dict[normalized_invoice_vendor]\n                vendor_id = matched_vendor['vendor_id']\n            else:\n                # Fuzzy matching\n                best_match = None\n                best_score = 0.0\n\n                for normalized_vendor_name, vendor_info in vendors_dict.items():\n                    score = similarity(normalized_invoice_vendor, normalized_vendor_name)\n                    # Threshold for considering it a match (e.g., 0.85 or higher)\n                    if score > best_score and score >= 0.85:\n                        best_score = score\n                        best_match = vendor_info\n\n                if best_match:\n                    matched_vendor = best_match\n                    vendor_id = matched_vendor['vendor_id']\n                else:\n                    # Unknown Vendor\n                    fraud_cases.append({\n                        \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                        \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                        \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                        \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                        \"po_number\": invoice.get('po_number'),\n                        \"reason\": \"Unknown Vendor\"\n                    })\n                    continue\n\n        # If we reach here and still no vendor, it's unknown\n        if not matched_vendor:\n            fraud_cases.append({\n                \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                \"vendor_name\": vendor_name if vendor_name else \"Unknown\",\n                \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                \"po_number\": invoice.get('po_number'),\n                \"reason\": \"Unknown Vendor\"\n            })\n            continue\n\n        # Criterion 2: Check IBAN mismatch\n        if invoice.get('iban') and matched_vendor.get('iban'):\n            if invoice['iban'].strip() != matched_vendor['iban'].strip():\n                fraud_cases.append({\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                    \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                    \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                    \"po_number\": invoice.get('po_number'),\n                    \"reason\": \"IBAN Mismatch\"\n                })\n                continue\n\n        # Criterion 3: Check if PO exists\n        po_number = invoice.get('po_number')\n        po_data = None\n\n        if po_number:\n            # Find matching PO\n            matched_po = None\n            for po_key in po_dict.keys():\n                if str(po_key).strip() == str(po_number).strip():\n                    matched_po = po_dict[po_key]\n                    break\n\n            if not matched_po:\n                # Invalid PO\n                fraud_cases.append({\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                    \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                    \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                    \"po_number\": po_number,\n                    \"reason\": \"Invalid PO\"\n                })\n                continue\n\n            po_data = matched_po\n\n            # Criterion 5: Check Vendor Mismatch (PO linked to different vendor)\n            if po_data['vendor_id'] != vendor_id:\n                fraud_cases.append({\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                    \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                    \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                    \"po_number\": po_number,\n                    \"reason\": \"Vendor Mismatch\"\n                })\n                continue\n\n            # Criterion 4: Check Amount Mismatch\n            if invoice.get('invoice_amount') is not None and po_data.get('amount') is not None:\n                invoice_amount = Decimal(str(invoice['invoice_amount']))\n                po_amount = Decimal(str(po_data['amount']))\n\n                # Check if difference exceeds 0.01\n                if abs(invoice_amount - po_amount) > Decimal('0.01'):\n                    fraud_cases.append({\n                        \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                        \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                        \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                        \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                        \"po_number\": po_number,\n                        \"reason\": \"Amount Mismatch\"\n                    })\n                    continue\n\n    return fraud_cases\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to process all files and generate fraud report.\"\"\"\n    print(\"Starting invoice fraud detection...\")\n\n    # Create PO lookup dictionary\n    po_dict = {}\n    for _, row in po_df.iterrows():\n        po_number = row['po_number']\n        po_dict[po_number] = {\n            'po_number': po_number,\n            'amount': row['amount'],\n            'vendor_id': row['vendor_id']\n        }","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nInvoice Fraud Detection Script\nAnalyzes invoices against vendor and purchase order data to detect fraud.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport pandas as pd\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation\nfrom difflib import SequenceMatcher\nimport PyPDF2\nimport pdfplumber\nfrom typing import List, Dict, Optional, Tuple\n\ndef similarity(a: str, b: str) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Calculate similarity between two strings using SequenceMatcher.\"\"\"\n    return SequenceMatcher(None, a.lower(), b.lower()).ratio()\n\ndef extract_invoice_data(pdf_path: str) -> List[Dict]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract invoice data from PDF.\n    Returns list of dicts with page_number, vendor_name, amount, iban, po_number.\n    \"\"\"\n    invoices = []\n\n    try:\n        with pdfplumber.open(pdf_path) as pdf:\n            for page_num, page in enumerate(pdf.pages, start=1):\n                text = page.extract_text()\n                if not text:\n                    continue\n\n                # Initialize invoice data\n                invoice_data = {\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": page_num,\n                    \"vendor_name\": None,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": None,\n                    \"iban\": None,\n                    \"po_number\": None\n                }\n\n                # Extract vendor name (usually at the top)\n                # Look for patterns like \"Vendor:\", \"From:\", or company names\n                vendor_patterns = [\n                    r'Vendor[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'From[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'Company[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'Supplier[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in vendor_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        vendor_name = match.group(1).strip()\n                        # Clean up common suffixes\n                        vendor_name = re.sub(r'\\s+(Ltd|Limited|Inc|Corp|Corporation|LLC|LLP)\\.?$', '', vendor_name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n                        vendor_name = vendor_name.strip()\n                        if len(vendor_name) > 2:\n                            invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = vendor_name\n                            break\n\n                # If no vendor found, try to find first line that looks like a company name\n                if not invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"]:\n                    lines = text.split('\\n')\n                    for line in lines[:10]:  # Check first 10 lines\n                        line = line.strip()\n                        if line and len(line) > 3 and not re.match(r'^(invoice|amount|total|date|#|no|number)', line, re.IGNORECASE):\n                            # Likely a vendor name\n                            invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = line\n                            break\n\n                # Extract amount (look for Total, Amount Due, etc.)\n                amount_patterns = [\n                    r'Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Amount Due[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Balance[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Grand Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Total Amount[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in amount_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        try:\n                            invoice_data[\"invoice_amount\"] = float(match.group(1))\n                            break\n                        except (ValueError, InvalidOperation):\n                            pass\n\n                # Extract IBAN (look for IBAN keyword or long alphanumeric strings)\n                iban_patterns = [\n                    r'IBAN[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)',\n                    r'Account[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in iban_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = match.group(1).strip()\n                        break\n\n                # If no IBAN found, look for long alphanumeric strings (15-34 chars)\n                if not invoice_data[\"iban\"]:\n                    iban_match = re.search(r'\\b([A-Z0-9]{15,34})\\b', text)\n                    if iban_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = iban_match.group(1)\n\n                # Extract PO Number\n                po_patterns = [\n                    r'PO Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'PO[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'Purchase Order[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'Order Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in po_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        invoice_data[\"po_number\"] = match.group(1).strip()\n                        break\n\n                invoices.append(invoice_data)\n\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error reading PDF: {e}\")\n        # Fallback to PyPDF2\n        try:\n            with open(pdf_path, 'rb') as f:\n                pdf_reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(f)\n                for page_num, page in enumerate(pdf_reader.pages, start=1):\n                    text = page.extract_text()\n                    if not text:\n                        continue\n\n                    invoice_data = {\n                        \"invoice_page_number\": page_num,\n                        \"vendor_name\": None,\n                        \"invoice_amount\": None,\n                        \"iban\": None,\n                        \"po_number\": None\n                    }\n\n                    # Extract similar to above\n                    vendor_match = re.search(r'Vendor[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if vendor_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = vendor_match.group(1).strip()\n\n                    amount_match = re.search(r'Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if amount_match:\n                        try:\n                            invoice_data[\"invoice_amount\"] = float(amount_match.group(1))\n                        except ValueError:\n                            pass\n\n                    iban_match = re.search(r'IBAN[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if iban_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = iban_match.group(1)\n\n                    po_match = re.search(r'PO Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if po_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"po_number\"] = po_match.group(1)\n\n                    invoices.append(invoice_data)\n        except Exception as e2:\n            print(f\"Error with PyPDF2 fallback: {e2}\")\n\n    return invoices\n\ndef normalize_vendor_name(name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Normalize vendor name for comparison.\"\"\"\n    if not name:\n        return \"\"\n    # Remove common business suffixes and normalize\n    name = re.sub(r'\\s+(Ltd|Limited|Inc|Corporation|Corp|LLC|LLP)\\.?$', '', name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n    # Remove extra spaces and convert to lowercase\n    return re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', name.strip().lower())\n\ndef detect_fraud(invoices: List[Dict], vendors_df: pd.DataFrame, po_df: pd.DataFrame) -> List[Dict]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Detect fraudulent invoices based on the criteria.\n    Returns list of fraudulent invoices with reasons.\n    \"\"\"\n    fraud_cases = []\n\n    # Create lookup dictionaries\n    vendors_dict = {}\n    for _, row in vendors_df.iterrows():\n        vendor_id = row['Vendor ID']\n        vendor_name = row['Name']\n        vendor_iban = row['IBAN']\n        vendors_dict[normalize_vendor_name(vendor_name)] = {\n            'vendor_id': vendor_id,\n            'vendor_name': vendor_name,\n            'iban': vendor_iban\n        }\n\n    # Create PO lookup dictionary\n    po_dict = {}\n    for _, row in po_df.iterrows():\n        po_number = row['PO Number']\n        po_dict[po_number] = {\n            'po_number': po_number,\n            'amount': row['Amount'],\n            'vendor_id': row['Vendor ID']\n        }\n\n    for invoice in invoices:\n        vendor_name = invoice.get('vendor_name')\n        vendor_id = None\n        matched_vendor = None\n\n        # Criterion 1: Check if vendor exists (with fuzzy matching)\n        if vendor_name:\n            normalized_invoice_vendor = normalize_vendor_name(vendor_name)\n\n            # Exact match first\n            if normalized_invoice_vendor in vendors_dict:\n                matched_vendor = vendors_dict[normalized_invoice_vendor]\n                vendor_id = matched_vendor['vendor_id']\n            else:\n                # Fuzzy matching\n                best_match = None\n                best_score = 0.0\n\n                for normalized_vendor_name, vendor_info in vendors_dict.items():\n                    score = similarity(normalized_invoice_vendor, normalized_vendor_name)\n                    # Threshold for considering it a match (e.g., 0.85 or higher)\n                    if score > best_score and score >= 0.85:\n                        best_score = score\n                        best_match = vendor_info\n\n                if best_match:\n                    matched_vendor = best_match\n                    vendor_id = matched_vendor['vendor_id']\n                else:\n                    # Unknown Vendor\n                    fraud_cases.append({\n                        \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                        \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                        \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                        \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                        \"po_number\": invoice.get('po_number'),\n                        \"reason\": \"Unknown Vendor\"\n                    })\n                    continue\n\n        # If we reach here and still no vendor, it's unknown\n        if not matched_vendor:\n            fraud_cases.append({\n                \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                \"vendor_name\": vendor_name if vendor_name else \"Unknown\",\n                \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                \"po_number\": invoice.get('po_number'),\n                \"reason\": \"Unknown Vendor\"\n            })\n            continue\n\n        # Criterion 2: Check IBAN mismatch\n        if invoice.get('iban') and matched_vendor.get('iban'):\n            if invoice['iban'].strip() != matched_vendor['iban'].strip():\n                fraud_cases.append({\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                    \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                    \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                    \"po_number\": invoice.get('po_number'),\n                    \"reason\": \"IBAN Mismatch\"\n                })\n                continue\n\n        # Initialize invoice data\n                invoice_data = {\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": page_num,\n                    \"vendor_name\": None,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": None,\n                    \"iban\": None,\n                    \"po_number\": None\n                }\n\n                # Extract vendor name (usually at the top)\n                # Look for patterns like \"Vendor:\", \"From:\", or company names\n                vendor_patterns = [\n                    r'Vendor[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'From[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'Company[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'Supplier[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in vendor_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        vendor_name = match.group(1).strip()\n                        # Clean up common suffixes\n                        vendor_name = re.sub(r'\\s+(Ltd|Limited|Inc|Corporation|Corp|LLC|LLP)\\.?$', '', vendor_name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n                        vendor_name = vendor_name.strip()\n                        if len(vendor_name) > 2:\n                            invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = vendor_name\n                            break\n\n                # If no vendor found, try to find first line that looks like a company name\n                if not invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"]:\n                    lines = text.split('\\n')\n                    for line in lines[:10]:  # Check first 10 lines\n                        line = line.strip()\n                        if line and len(line) > 3 and not re.match(r'^(invoice|amount|total|date|#|no|number)', line, re.IGNORECASE):\n                            # Likely a vendor name\n                            invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = line\n                            break\n\n                # Extract amount (look for Total, Amount Due, etc.)\n                amount_patterns = [\n                    r'Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Amount Due[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Balance[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Grand Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Total Amount[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in amount_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        try:\n                            invoice_data[\"invoice_amount\"] = float(match.group(1))\n                            break\n                        except (ValueError, InvalidOperation):\n                            pass\n\n                # Extract IBAN (look for IBAN keyword or long alphanumeric strings)\n                iban_patterns = [\n                    r'IBAN[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)',\n                    r'Account[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in iban_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = match.group(1).strip()\n                        break\n\n                # If no IBAN found, look for long alphanumeric strings (15-34 chars)\n                if not invoice_data[\"iban\"]:\n                    iban_match = re.search(r'\\b([A-Z0-9]{15,34})\\b', text)\n                    if iban_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = iban_match.group(1)\n\n                # Extract PO Number\n                po_patterns = [\n                    r'PO Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'PO[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'Purchase Order[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'Order Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in po_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        invoice_data[\"po_number\"] = match.group(1).strip()\n                        break\n\n                invoices.append(invoice_data)\n\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error reading PDF: {e}\")\n\n    return invoices\n\n# Extract data\ninvoices = extract_invoice_data(\"/root/invoices.pdf\")\n\n# Show first 10 invoices\nprint(\"First 10 extracted invoices:\")\nfor i in range(min(10, len(invoices))):\n    inv = invoices[i]\n    print(f\"\\nPage {inv['invoice_page_number']}:\")\n    print(f\"  Vendor: {inv['vendor_name']}\")\n    print(f\"  Amount: {inv['invoice_amount']}\")\n    print(f\"  IBAN: {inv['iban']}\")\n    print(f\"  PO Number: {inv['po_number']}\")\n"}}],"model":"MiniMax-M2","stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":146,"output_tokens":0,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1662,"cache_read_input_tokens":25419},"service_tier":"standard","context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d056aca0-c4ae-4c2e-9fd3-a1cfe18c4c61","uuid":"cada5335-9975-4a87-b079-a97533d3c4c8"}

Initialize invoice data\n                invoice_data = {\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": page_num,\n                    \"vendor_name\": None,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": None,\n                    \"iban\": None,\n                    \"po_number\": None\n                }\n\n                # Extract vendor name (usually at the top)\n                # Look for patterns like \"Vendor:\", \"From:\", or company names\n                vendor_patterns = [\n                    r'Vendor[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'From[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'Company[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                    r'Supplier[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in vendor_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        vendor_name = match.group(1).strip()\n                        # Clean up common suffixes\n                        vendor_name = re.sub(r'\\s+(Ltd|Limited|Inc|Corp|Corporation|LLC|LLP)\\.?$', '', vendor_name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n                        vendor_name = vendor_name.strip()\n                        if len(vendor_name) > 2:\n                            invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = vendor_name\n                            break\n\n                # If no vendor found, try to find first line that looks like a company name\n                if not invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"]:\n                    lines = text.split('\\n')\n                    for line in lines[:10]:  # Check first 10 lines\n                        line = line.strip()\n                        if line and len(line) > 3 and not re.match(r'^(invoice|amount|total|date|#|no|number)', line, re.IGNORECASE):\n                            # Likely a vendor name\n                            invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = line\n                            break\n\n                # Extract amount (look for Total, Amount Due, etc.)\n                amount_patterns = [\n                    r'Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Amount Due[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Balance[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Grand Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Total Amount[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in amount_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        try:\n                            invoice_data[\"invoice_amount\"] = float(match.group(1))\n                            break\n                        except (ValueError, InvalidOperation):\n                            pass\n\n                # Extract IBAN (look for IBAN keyword or long alphanumeric strings)\n                iban_patterns = [\n                    r'IBAN[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)',\n                    r'Account[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in iban_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = match.group(1).strip()\n                        break\n\n                # If no IBAN found, look for long alphanumeric strings (15-34 chars)\n                if not invoice_data[\"iban\"]:\n                    iban_match = re.search(r'\\b([A-Z0-9]{15,34})\\b', text)\n                    if iban_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = iban_match.group(1)\n\n                # Extract PO Number\n                po_patterns = [\n                    r'PO Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'PO[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'Purchase Order[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'Order Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in po_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        invoice_data[\"po_number\"] = match.group(1).strip()\n                        break\n\n                invoices.append(invoice_data)\n\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error reading PDF: {e}\")\n        # Fallback to PyPDF2\n        try:\n            with open(pdf_path, 'rb') as f:\n                pdf_reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(f)\n                for page_num, page in enumerate(pdf_reader.pages, start=1):\n                    text = page.extract_text()\n                    if not text:\n                        continue\n\n                    invoice_data = {\n                        \"invoice_page_number\": page_num,\n                        \"vendor_name\": None,\n                        \"invoice_amount\": None,\n                        \"iban\": None,\n                        \"po_number\": None\n                    }\n\n                    # Extract similar to above\n                    vendor_match = re.search(r'Vendor[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if vendor_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = vendor_match.group(1).strip()\n\n                    amount_match = re.search(r'Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if amount_match:\n                        try:\n                            invoice_data[\"invoice_amount\"] = float(amount_match.group(1))\n                        except ValueError:\n                            pass\n\n                    iban_match = re.search(r'IBAN[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if iban_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = iban_match.group(1)\n\n                    po_match = re.search(r'PO Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if po_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"po_number\"] = po_match.group(1)\n\n                    invoices.append(invoice_data)\n        except Exception as e2:\n            print(f\"Error with PyPDF2 fallback: {e2}\")\n\n    return invoices\n\ndef normalize_vendor_name(name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Normalize vendor name for comparison.\"\"\"\n    if not name:\n        return \"\"\n    # Remove common business suffixes and normalize\n    name = re.sub(r'\\s+(Ltd|Limited|Inc|Corporation|Corp|LLC|LLP)\\.?$', '', name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n    # Remove extra spaces and convert to lowercase\n    return re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', name.strip().lower())\n\ndef detect_fraud(invoices: List[Dict], vendors_df: pd.DataFrame, po_df: pd.DataFrame) -> List[Dict]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Detect fraudulent invoices based on the criteria.\n    Returns list of fraudulent invoices with reasons.\n    \"\"\"\n    fraud_cases = []\n\n    # Create lookup dictionaries\n    vendors_dict = {}\n    for _, row in vendors_df.iterrows():\n        vendor_id = row['id']\n        vendor_name = row['name']\n        vendor_iban = row['iban']\n        vendors_dict[normalize_vendor_name(vendor_name)] = {\n            'vendor_id': vendor_id,\n            'vendor_name': vendor_name,\n            'iban': vendor_iban\n        }\n\n    # Create PO lookup dictionary\n    po_dict = {}\n    for _, row in po_df.iterrows():\n        po_number = row['po_number']\n        po_dict[po_number] = {\n            'po_number': po_number,\n            'amount': row['amount'],\n            'vendor_id': row['vendor_id']\n        }\n\n    for invoice in invoices:\n        vendor_name = invoice.get('vendor_name')\n        vendor_id = None\n        matched_vendor = None\n\n        # Criterion 1: Check if vendor exists (with fuzzy matching)\n        if vendor_name:\n            normalized_invoice_vendor = normalize_vendor_name(vendor_name)\n\n            # Exact match first\n            if normalized_invoice_vendor in vendors_dict:\n                matched_vendor = vendors_dict[normalized_invoice_vendor]\n                vendor_id = matched_vendor['vendor_id']\n            else:\n                # Fuzzy matching\n                best_match = None\n                best_score = 0.0\n\n                for normalized_vendor_name, vendor_info in vendors_dict.items():\n                    score = similarity(normalized_invoice_vendor, normalized_vendor_name)\n                    # Threshold for considering it a match (e.g., 0.85 or higher)\n                    if score > best_score and score >= 0.85:\n                        best_score = score\n                        best_match = vendor_info\n\n                if best_match:\n                    matched_vendor = best_match\n                    vendor_id = matched_vendor['vendor_id']\n                else:\n                    # Unknown Vendor\n                    fraud_cases.append({\n                        \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                        \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                        \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                        \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                        \"po_number\": invoice.get('po_number'),\n                        \"reason\": \"Unknown Vendor\"\n                    })\n                    continue\n\n        # If we reach here and still no vendor, it's unknown\n        if not matched_vendor:\n            fraud_cases.append({\n                \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                \"vendor_name\": vendor_name if vendor_name else \"Unknown\",\n                \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                \"po_number\": invoice.get('po_number'),\n                \"reason\": \"Unknown Vendor\"\n            })\n            continue\n\n        # Criterion 2: Check IBAN mismatch\n        if invoice.get('iban') and matched_vendor.get('iban'):\n            if invoice['iban'].strip() != matched_vendor['iban'].strip():\n                fraud_cases.append({\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                    \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                    \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                    \"po_number\": invoice.get('po_number'),\n                    \"reason\": \"IBAN Mismatch\"\n                })\n                continue\n\n        # Criterion 3: Check if PO exists\n        po_number = invoice.get('po_number')\n        po_data = None\n\n        if po_number:\n            # Find matching PO\n            matched_po = None\n            for po_key in po_dict.keys():\n                if str(po_key).strip() == str(po_number).strip():\n                    matched_po = po_dict[po_key]\n                    break\n\n            if not matched_po:\n                # Invalid PO\n                fraud_cases.append({\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                    \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                    \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                    \"po_number\": po_number,\n                    \"reason\": \"Invalid PO\"\n                })\n                continue\n\n            po_data = matched_po\n\n            # Criterion 5: Check Vendor Mismatch (PO linked to different vendor)\n            if po_data['vendor_id'] != vendor_id:\n                fraud_cases.append({\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                    \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                    \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                    \"po_number\": po_number,\n                    \"reason\": \"Vendor Mismatch\"\n                })\n                continue\n\n            # Criterion 4: Check Amount Mismatch\n            if invoice.get('invoice_amount') is not None and po_data.get('amount') is not None:\n                invoice_amount = Decimal(str(invoice['invoice_amount']))\n                po_amount = Decimal(str(po_data['amount']))\n\n                # Check if difference exceeds 0.01\n                if abs(invoice_amount - po_amount) > Decimal('0.01'):\n                    fraud_cases.append({\n                        \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                        \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                        \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                        \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                        \"po_number\": po_number,\n                        \"reason\": \"Amount Mismatch\"\n                    })\n                    continue\n\n    return fraud_cases\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to process all files and generate fraud report.\"\"\"\n    print(\"Starting invoice fraud detection...\")\n\n    # File paths\n    pdf_path = \"/root/invoices.pdf\"\n    vendors_path = \"/root/vendors.xlsx\"\n    po_path = \"/root/purchase_orders.csv\"\n    output_path = \"/root/fraud_report.json\"\n\n    # Extract invoice data from PDF\n    print(\"Extracting invoice data from PDF...\")\n    invoices = extract_invoice_data(pdf_path)\n    print(f\"Found {len(invoices)} invoices\")\n\n    # Read vendor data\n    print(\"Reading vendor data...\")\n    vendors_df = pd.read_excel(vendors_path)\n    print(f\"Found {len(vendors_df)} vendors\")\n\n    # Read purchase order data\n    print(\"Reading purchase order data...\")\n    po_df = pd.read_csv(po_path)\n    print(f\"Found {len(po_df)} purchase orders\")\n\n    # Detect fraud\n    print(\"Analyzing invoices for fraud...\")\n    fraud_cases = detect_fraud(invoices, vendors_df, po_df)\n\n    # Save results\n    print(f\"Found {len(fraud_cases)} fraudulent invoices\")\n    with open(output_path, 'w') as f:\n        json.dump(fraud_cases, f, indent=2)\n\n    print(f\"Fraud report saved to {output_path}\")\n\n    # Print summary\n    if fraud_cases:\n        print(\"\\nFraud cases found:\")\n        for case in fraud_cases:\n            print(f\"  Page {case['invoice_page_number']}: {case['reason']}\")\n    else:\n        print(\"\\nNo fraud detected!\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":43,"oldLines":10,"newStart":43,"newLines":10,"lines":["                 # Extract PO Number\n                po_patterns = [\n                    r'PO Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+?)(?:\\n|$)',\n                    r'PO[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+?)(?:\\n|$)',\n                    r'Purchase Order[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+?)(?:\\n|$)',\n                    r'Order Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+?)(?:\\n|$)',\n                ]","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nInvoice Fraud Detection Script\nAnalyzes invoices against vendor and purchase order data to detect fraud.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport pandas as pd\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation\nfrom difflib import SequenceMatcher\nimport PyPDF2\nimport pdfplumber\nfrom typing import List, Dict, Optional, Tuple\n\ndef similarity(a: str, b: str) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Calculate similarity between two strings using SequenceMatcher.\"\"\"\n    return SequenceMatcher(None, a.lower(), b.lower()).ratio()\n\ndef extract_invoice_data(pdf_path: str) -> List[Dict]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract invoice data from PDF.\n    Returns list of dicts with page_number, vendor_name, amount, iban, po_number.\n    \"\"\"\n    invoices = []\n\n    try:\n        with pdfplumber.open(pdf_path) as pdf:\n            for page_num, page in enumerate(pdf.pages, start=1):\n                text = page.extract_text()\n                if not text:\n                    continue\n\n                # Initialize invoice data\n                invoice_data = {\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": page_num,\n                    \"vendor_name\": None,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": None,\n                    \"iban\": None,\n                    \"po_number\": None\n                }\n\n                # Extract vendor name (usually at the top)\n                # Look for patterns like \"Vendor:\", \"From:\", or company names\n                vendor_patterns = [\n                    r'Vendor[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+?)(?:\\n|$)',\n                    r'From[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+?)(?:\\n|$)',\n                    r'Company[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+?)(?:\\n|$)',\n                    r'Supplier[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+?)(?:\\n|$)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in vendor_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        vendor_name = match.group(1).strip()\n                        # Clean up common suffixes\n                        vendor_name = re.sub(r'\\s+(Ltd|Limited|Inc|Corp|Corporation|LLC|LLP)\\.?$', '', vendor_name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n                        vendor_name = vendor_name.strip()\n                        if len(vendor_name) > 2:\n                            invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = vendor_name\n                            break\n\n                # If no vendor found, try to find first line that looks like a company name\n                if not invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"]:\n                    lines = text.split('\\n')\n                    for line in lines[:10]:  # Check first 10 lines\n                        line = line.strip()\n                        if line and len(line) > 3 and not re.match(r'^(invoice|amount|total|date|#|no|number)', line, re.IGNORECASE):\n                            # Likely a vendor name\n                            invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = line\n                            break\n\n                # Extract amount (look for Total, Amount Due, etc.)\n                amount_patterns = [\n                    r'Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Amount Due[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Balance[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Grand Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                    r'Total Amount[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in amount_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        try:\n                            invoice_data[\"invoice_amount\"] = float(match.group(1))\n                            break\n                        except (ValueError, InvalidOperation):\n                            pass\n\n                # Extract IBAN (look for IBAN keyword or long alphanumeric strings)\n                iban_patterns = [\n                    r'IBAN[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)',\n                    r'Account[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in iban_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = match.group(1).strip()\n                        break\n\n                # If no IBAN found, look for long alphanumeric strings (15-34 chars)\n                if not invoice_data[\"iban\"]:\n                    iban_match = re.search(r'\\b([A-Z0-9]{15,34})\\b', text)\n                    if iban_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = iban_match.group(1)\n\n                # Extract PO Number\n                po_patterns = [\n                    r'PO Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'PO[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'Purchase Order[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                    r'Order Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)',\n                ]\n\n                for pattern in po_patterns:\n                    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if match:\n                        invoice_data[\"po_number\"] = match.group(1).strip()\n                        break\n\n                invoices.append(invoice_data)\n\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error reading PDF: {e}\")\n        # Fallback to PyPDF2\n        try:\n            with open(pdf_path, 'rb') as f:\n                pdf_reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(f)\n                for page_num, page in enumerate(pdf_reader.pages, start=1):\n                    text = page.extract_text()\n                    if not text:\n                        continue\n\n                    invoice_data = {\n                        \"invoice_page_number\": page_num,\n                        \"vendor_name\": None,\n                        \"invoice_amount\": None,\n                        \"iban\": None,\n                        \"po_number\": None\n                    }\n\n                    # Extract similar to above\n                    vendor_match = re.search(r'Vendor[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9&\\s\\.,-]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if vendor_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"vendor_name\"] = vendor_match.group(1).strip()\n\n                    amount_match = re.search(r'Total[:\\s]+\\$?(\\d+\\.?\\d*)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if amount_match:\n                        try:\n                            invoice_data[\"invoice_amount\"] = float(amount_match.group(1))\n                        except ValueError:\n                            pass\n\n                    iban_match = re.search(r'IBAN[:\\s]+([A-Z0-9]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if iban_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"iban\"] = iban_match.group(1)\n\n                    po_match = re.search(r'PO Number[:\\s]+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if po_match:\n                        invoice_data[\"po_number\"] = po_match.group(1)\n\n                    invoices.append(invoice_data)\n        except Exception as e2:\n            print(f\"Error with PyPDF2 fallback: {e2}\")\n\n    return invoices\n\ndef normalize_vendor_name(name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Normalize vendor name for comparison.\"\"\"\n    if not name:\n        return \"\"\n    # Remove common business suffixes and normalize\n    name = re.sub(r'\\s+(Ltd|Limited|Inc|Corporation|Corp|LLC|LLP)\\.?$', '', name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n    # Remove extra spaces and convert to lowercase\n    return re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', name.strip().lower())\n\ndef detect_fraud(invoices: List[Dict], vendors_df: pd.DataFrame, po_df: pd.DataFrame) -> List[Dict]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Detect fraudulent invoices based on the criteria.\n    Returns list of fraudulent invoices with reasons.\n    \"\"\"\n    fraud_cases = []\n\n    # Create lookup dictionaries\n    vendors_dict = {}\n    for _, row in vendors_df.iterrows():\n        vendor_id = row['id']\n        vendor_name = row['name']\n        vendor_iban = row['iban']\n        vendors_dict[normalize_vendor_name(vendor_name)] = {\n            'vendor_id': vendor_id,\n            'vendor_name': vendor_name,\n            'iban': vendor_iban\n        }\n\n    # Create PO lookup dictionary\n    po_dict = {}\n    for _, row in po_df.iterrows():\n        po_number = row['po_number']\n        po_dict[po_number] = {\n            'po_number': po_number,\n            'amount': row['amount'],\n            'vendor_id': row['vendor_id']\n        }\n\n    for invoice in invoices:\n        vendor_name = invoice.get('vendor_name')\n        vendor_id = None\n        matched_vendor = None\n\n        # Criterion 1: Check if vendor exists (with fuzzy matching)\n        if vendor_name:\n            normalized_invoice_vendor = normalize_vendor_name(vendor_name)\n\n            # Exact match first\n            if normalized_invoice_vendor in vendors_dict:\n                matched_vendor = vendors_dict[normalized_invoice_vendor]\n                vendor_id = matched_vendor['vendor_id']\n            else:\n                # Fuzzy matching\n                best_match = None\n                best_score = 0.0\n\n                for normalized_vendor_name, vendor_info in vendors_dict.items():\n                    score = similarity(normalized_invoice_vendor, normalized_vendor_name)\n                    # Threshold for considering it a match (e.g., 0.85 or higher)\n                    if score > best_score and score >= 0.85:\n                        best_score = score\n                        best_match = vendor_info\n\n                if best_match:\n                    matched_vendor = best_match\n                    vendor_id = matched_vendor['vendor_id']\n                else:\n                    # Unknown Vendor\n                    fraud_cases.append({\n                        \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                        \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                        \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                        \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                        \"po_number\": invoice.get('po_number'),\n                        \"reason\": \"Unknown Vendor\"\n                    })\n                    continue\n\n        # If we reach here and still no vendor, it's unknown\n        if not matched_vendor:\n            fraud_cases.append({\n                \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                \"vendor_name\": vendor_name if vendor_name else \"Unknown\",\n                \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                \"po_number\": invoice.get('po_number'),\n                \"reason\": \"Unknown Vendor\"\n            })\n            continue\n\n        # Criterion 2: Check IBAN mismatch\n        if invoice.get('iban') and matched_vendor.get('iban'):\n            if invoice['iban'].strip() != matched_vendor['iban'].strip():\n                fraud_cases.append({\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                    \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                    \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                    \"po_number\": invoice.get('po_number'),\n                    \"reason\": \"IBAN Mismatch\"\n                })\n                continue\n\n        # Criterion 3: Check if PO exists\n        po_number = invoice.get('po_number')\n        po_data = None\n\n        if po_number:\n            # Find matching PO\n            matched_po = None\n            for po_key in po_dict.keys():\n                if str(po_key).strip() == str(po_number).strip():\n                    matched_po = po_dict[po_key]\n                    break\n\n            if not matched_po:\n                # Invalid PO\n                fraud_cases.append({\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                    \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                    \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                    \"po_number\": po_number,\n                    \"reason\": \"Invalid PO\"\n                })\n                continue\n\n            po_data = matched_po\n\n            # Criterion 5: Check Vendor Mismatch (PO linked to different vendor)\n            if po_data['vendor_id'] != vendor_id:\n                fraud_cases.append({\n                    \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                    \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                    \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                    \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                    \"po_number\": po_number,\n                    \"reason\": \"Vendor Mismatch\"\n                })\n                continue\n\n            # Criterion 4: Check Amount Mismatch\n            if invoice.get('invoice_amount') is not None and po_data.get('amount') is not None:\n                invoice_amount = Decimal(str(invoice['invoice_amount']))\n                po_amount = Decimal(str(po_data['amount']))\n\n                # Check if difference exceeds 0.01\n                if abs(invoice_amount - po_amount) > Decimal('0.01'):\n                    fraud_cases.append({\n                        \"invoice_page_number\": invoice['invoice_page_number'],\n                        \"vendor_name\": vendor_name,\n                        \"invoice_amount\": invoice.get('invoice_amount'),\n                        \"iban\": invoice.get('iban'),\n                        \"po_number\": po_number,\n                        \"reason\": \"Amount Mismatch\"\n                    })\n                    continue\n\n    return fraud_cases\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to process all files and generate fraud report.\"\"\"\n    print(\"Starting invoice fraud detection...\")\n\n    # File paths\n    pdf_path = \"/root/invoices.pdf\"\n    vendors_path = \"/root/vendors.xlsx\"\n    po_path = \"/root/purchase_orders.csv\"\n    output_path = \"/root/fraud_report.json\"\n\n    # Extract invoice data from PDF\n    print(\"Extracting invoice data from PDF...\")\n    invoices = extract_invoice_data(pdf_path)\n    print(f\"Found {len(invoices)} invoices\")\n\n    # Read vendor data\n    print(\"Reading vendor data...\")\n    vendors_df = pd.read_excel(vendors_path)\n    print(f\"Found {len(vendors_df)} vendors\")\n\n    # Read purchase order data\n    print(\"Reading purchase order data...\")\n    po_df = pd.read_csv(po_path)\n    print(f\"Found {len(po_df)} purchase orders\")\n\n    # Detect fraud\n    print(\"Analyzing invoices for fraud...\")\n    fraud_cases = detect_fraud(invoices, vendors_df, po_df)\n\n    # Save results\n    print(f\"Found {len(fraud_cases)} fraudulent invoices\")\n    with open(output_path, 'w') as f:\n        json.dump(fraud_cases, f, indent=2)\n\n    print(f\"Fraud report saved to {output_path}\")\n\n    # Print summary\n    if fraud_cases:\n        print(\"\\nFraud cases found:\")\n        for case in fraud_cases:\n            print(f\"  Page {case['invoice_page_number']}: {case['reason']}\")\n    else:\n        print(\"\\nNo fraud detected!\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":108,"oldLines":10,"newStart":108,"newLines":10,"lines":[" ","                 #
